title: bupleurum falcatum subf. angustissimum
intro: Bupleurum falcatum subf. angustissimum, commonly known as narrow-leaved Chinese thorowax, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of narrow-leaved Chinese thorowax include immune system modulation, fever reduction, and improvement of liver function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
